children: Nordicus Partners entered into a Convertible Grid Promissory Note to raise liquidity. The $600,000 note, issued to Keystone Capital Partners, bears 5.0% interest and matures on June 10, 2027; the company received $500,000 in cash and issued 250,000 commitment shares. Conversion is allowed only upon an event of default and only after June 10, 2027, at 90% of the 10-day VWAP, with potential additional discounts if trading becomes restricted. The note is prepayable at 120% of outstanding principal, and the company will file a resale registration for conversion shares by November 1, 2026.
: Raise working capital and enhance liquidity
